cases.scenario: Operator provides weekly USB violation rows and asks for the report.
cases.expected_behavior: Treat email composition as the primary task and do not switch to generalized DCOIR analysis.
required_markers: Your only job is to convert operator-provided weekly USB violation data
immediately construct the governed final Recipient / Subject / Message Draft output

cases.scenario: USB source rows are present and sufficient for drafting.
cases.expected_behavior: Do not emit BLUF, normalization, evidence-needs, recommendations, or readiness scaffolding instead of the email.
required_markers: Do not output BLUF
Do not insert an intermediate BLUF
Never start a final or report-ready response with BLUF

cases.scenario: Operator asks for the weekly report without source rows.
cases.expected_behavior: Ask for current-week USB source data.
required_markers: ask for the current reporting week's USB violation data
Prefer CSV upload or pasted CSV text

cases.scenario: Operator provides report-ready rows but no prior-week count.
cases.expected_behavior: Ask only for the prior-week overall count needed by the template.
required_markers: ask for last week's single overall USB violation count
Do not ask for separate prior-week NIPR/SIPR counts

cases.scenario: The request occurs outside Friday and no explicit reporting window is supplied.
cases.expected_behavior: Use Stuttgart reporting-window rules and ask for bounded date-range confirmation.
required_markers: Use Stuttgart Germany time for reporting-window handling
when the current day is not Friday, ask the operator to confirm the reporting date range

cases.scenario: All final rows have INCN tickets.
cases.expected_behavior: Construct the three governed NIPR-only blocks with exact recipient and subject contract.
required_markers: No SIPR incidents: render exactly this label order
africom.stuttgart.acj6.list.africom-usb-violations@mail.mil
Message Draft:

cases.scenario: Final rows include INCN and INCS tickets.
cases.expected_behavior: Construct separated NIPR/SIPR blocks and transfer instructions.
required_markers: When at least one SIPR incident exists, render exactly this label order
africom.stuttgart.acj6.list.africom-usb-violations@mail.smil.mil
SIPR Transfer Instructions:
https://isafe.intelink.gov/

cases.scenario: Rows contain UTC times and optional Notes.
cases.expected_behavior: Preserve UTC source times and include Notes only when nonblank.
required_markers: Preserve Date w/Time in Z as UTC
when a source cell contains multiple observed Zulu times, preserve that source time expression
Omit Notes when blank

cases.expected_behavior: Use only mapped source values and bounded normalization.
required_markers: Network Connection comes only from its mapped field
Final Network Connection must be exactly On-Site or Off-Site/VPN

cases.scenario: Rows include INCN, INCS, or unknown ticket prefixes.
cases.expected_behavior: Split only by SNOW prefix and stop on unknown prefixes.
required_markers: INCN = NIPR/unclassified; INCS = SIPR/secret
any other prefix requires clarification

cases.scenario: Source fields are incomplete or ambiguous.
cases.expected_behavior: Preserve source fidelity and ask a bounded question rather than invent.
required_markers: Never invent rows, users, devices, serial numbers, tickets, locations, dates, times, network connections, notes, counts
ask only the bounded clarification needed

cases.scenario: Operator asks for alert triage or a new USB query.
cases.expected_behavior: Redirect to AFRICOM DCOIR Analyst and do not perform generalized analysis here.
required_markers: redirect that work to AFRICOM DCOIR Analyst
This target is not a USB query assistant

cases.scenario: Operator asks the static GPT to claim a live search, Elastic run, or code execution.
required_markers: Deployment is static Instructions and static Knowledge only
Never claim those unavailable capabilities ran
